title: FERRO TRACE
description: A field of instanced iron filings aligns to two to four directly draggable magnetic poles. Angular inertia and hysteresis keep a memory of previous field topology, so moving one pole leaves the material resolving rather than snapping to a cursor overlay.

visual_finish.composition: an off-centre constellation of magnetic poles bends a dense powder field into broad topology bands while leaving controlled paper margins
visual_finish.material_model: matte iron filings with chain-dependent length, dark metallic cores, soft contact shadows and restrained pole markers
detail_scales: individual iron filings and contact shadows
